title: summary_snapshot holds the state lock ~340 ms scanning and projecting every session's metadata
outcome: immutable_state_snapshot_locked (used by summary_snapshot/snapshot callers and general commits) captures only cheap immutable inputs under StateInner and does the per-session scan, projection, serialization and hashing off-lock, by extending the existing immutable-cut/cache owner from w-de6021f4b32f rather than adding a parallel cache, with snapshot/delta ordering and revision cuts unchanged.
acceptance: Under the state lock, building a summary snapshot no longer scans, projects, serializes or hashes every session's metadata and queue identities; it captures immutable shared inputs (or reuses validated cached projections) and the per-session work runs after release, through the existing immutable-cut/cache owner.

Tests show the materialized StateResponse is equal to the current implementation's for representative states, including cache-hit, cache-miss and concurrent-mutation cases, and that snapshot/delta ordering, revision cuts and cache validation are unchanged.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding and the full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
